metaDescription: Italian Greyhound vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Italian Greyhound boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Why timing is non-negotiable for Italian Greyhounds: each booster lands after the previous dose’s immunology window, usually every 2–4 weeks, until the Italian Greyhound series closes at about 16 weeks.
Size class toy does not invent new viruses for the Italian Greyhound, but it does change crate fit, blood-draw ease, and how early you lock travel relative to the final DA2PP / DHPP booster.
Flag progressive retinal atrophy (pra) at Italian Greyhound vaccine checkups so the puppy’s chart accumulates breed-relevant context, not just sticker dates.
When the Italian Greyhound series is complete, switch reminders to adult booster cadence instead of deleting the vaccine thread entirely.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Italian Greyhound shots when the puppy seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or dental disease worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Italian Greyhound make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Italian Greyhound antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Italian Greyhound dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this toy dog.
Reset the Italian Greyhound reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Italian Greyhound core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Italian Greyhound misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Italian Greyhound health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Italian Greyhound adult health guide for breed predispositions such as dental disease, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
